'''Austin''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Imperial Corrections Officer]] during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Austin joined the [[Imperial Corrections Service]] and served aboard the [[Imperial prison barge]] [[Purge (prison barge)|''Purge'']]. He was aboard the barge in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] when it broke down while en route to the [[detainment moon]] [[Gradient Seven]]. Austin was selected to be part of a boarding party that was to travel from the ''Purge'' to a nearby abandoned [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], to search for spare parts to try and repair the barge with. The team was led by [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] [[Jareth Sartoris]] and it made it's way onto the Star Destroyer through a docking shaft. They then split into two and Sartoris, Austin, the Imperial Corrections Officer [[Vesek]], and the engineers [[Blandings]] and [[Greeley (engineer)|Greeley]] made their way to the Star Destroyer's maintenance level, where they found some parts. Austin [[Death/Legends|died]] from the [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing]] virus shortly afterward.<ref name="DT" />
